sections.Profile:
Beat Time , released by Williams in September 1967, is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Steve Kordek with artwork by Jerry Kelley. It is notable for featuring a parody of The Beatles, named "The Bootles," on the backglass.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1967
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Good Times, Singing, Music
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Jerry Kelley
- Design: Steve Kordek
